comment: Driver sources the DOOM Mobile driver manager lists under Download (DriverManager.java, BUGS_AND_FIXES 2.39). The app fetches this file (cached for 6 h; the APK carries a copy for offline use), then for each source whose family fits the phone (all of them with 'Show all GPUs') the GitHub releases API https://api.github.com/repos/<repo>/releases?per_page=10. repo = owner/name; family = adreno | mali | xclipse | powervr | any; include / exclude = Java regexes (find) over the release asset names (include defaults to names ending in .zip); gpu = optional Java regex over /sys/class/kgsl/kgsl-3d0/gpu_model (e.g. Adreno750v2): when set, the source is listed only on matching GPUs unless 'Show all' is ticked; note = a line under the title; tags = [{match: regex over the asset name, text: label shown beside it}]. Only Android (bionic) adrenotools packages (meta.json + driver .so) work; the app checks every download (GPU family, glibc build, missing libraries, meta.json minApi) and removes it when it cannot run on the phone.

sources.title: Mesa Turnip (The412Banner)
sources.note: Mesa Turnip for Adreno 6xx/7xx; -A8xx = Adreno 8xx (Snapdragon 8 Elite), -710-720-Test = Adreno 710/720/722, -8G2-OneUI = Adreno 740 on newer firmware, Banners-AIO = all in one.

sources.title: AdrenoToolsDrivers (K11MCH1): Turnip builds + Qualcomm drivers
sources.note: Turnip_* = Mesa Turnip builds; Qualcomm_<version>_adpkg / 8Elite* = Qualcomm's own proprietary driver extracted from a device (closed source, for recent Adreno only; meta.json minApi is checked).

sources.note: Mesa RADV for Samsung Exynos Xclipse 920 / 940 / 950; Android 14+. Experimental.
